purpose: Frozen explanatory comparison only; the legacy calculation is not a supported test oracle.

legacy_snapshot.source: retained class-session calculation executed once before legacy cleanup
legacy_snapshot.input_interpretation: The same 15 selected rows were treated as one location-wide beacon stream. Station totals were summed per fixture bin only to satisfy the historical room_scount input.

intentional_differences: The historical class calculation mixed every radio in the classroom; corrected streaks are calculated per stable radio before taking the classroom maximum.
The corrected result reports actual-observed and possible-connected streaks separately.
The corrected result preserves the 0.308-second terminal partial interval; the historical date-range loop omitted it.
The historical average weighted beacon rows and mixed radios; the corrected artifacts report per-radio duration-weighted valid-CU averages and intentionally omit a combined classroom CU average.
Missing CU and no-beacon time remain distinct in the corrected result rather than being treated as measured zero.
